summary: Workday, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026 disclosing that on October 12, 2026 it entered a definitive agreement to acquire all outstanding capital stock of ConductorOne, Inc. (C1.ai), subject to customary closing conditions. No purchase price, per-share consideration, premium, financing, or expected closing date was disclosed in the excerpt. Workday casts the deal as becoming the identity governance layer for people, money, and agents, integrating C1.ai's technology. The filing is a US current report; watch for 8-K/A or merger proxy details on price, retention, and antitrust timing, plus integration risk to Workday's shares.
